handy when you want to tune or inspect the classification:

.. code-block:: python

  from justext.core import (
    html_to_dom, preprocessor, ParagraphMaker,
    classify_paragraphs, revise_paragraph_classification,
  )
  from justext.utils import get_stoplist, get_stoplists

  dom = preprocessor(html_to_dom(html_string))     # drop head/script/style/comments
  paragraphs = ParagraphMaker.make_paragraphs(dom) # DOM -> [Paragraph]

  classify_paragraphs(paragraphs, get_stoplist("English"))  # sets .cf_class
  revise_paragraph_classification(paragraphs)               # sets .class_type
